svg.title: Save a credential draft
svg.desc: WinUI validates required editor fields, Presentation checks the current login, and Core validates and applies an add or update in memory. Core encrypts the entire vault and commits config and storage together. Failed persistence restores the in-memory mutation when the session still exists; cancelled drafts are discarded.

g.text: Read arrows in order. SECRET = plaintext; KEY = encryption key; cylinders = stored data.
